title: Yugioh Yu-Gi-Oh Griggle DB1-EN011 Common Unlimited Edition
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This is a rare and highly sought-after Yugioh card featuring the character Griggle. It is a Japanese-sized card made of high-quality card stock with a regular finish. The card is an unlimited edition and is part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game.

The card is classified as a common rarity and belongs to the Yugi set. It is an effect type card with the card number DB1-EN011. The card is in excellent shape and is perfect for collectors and players alike. It is a vintage card manufactured by Konami in 1996. The card is graded as near mint or better and is available in English language.
